note: Family-run resort campground on Orr Bay of Pelican Lake across the bay from Orr, with lakefront cabins, a lodge store, swimming beach, boat slips, launch and boat rentals; some sites are seasonal. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: ~80 sites (20 full hookup, 30 lakefront with docking, 30 hill electric/water), $48 cheapest RV site, $55 lakefront/sewer, phone or contact-form booking. Passes the price gate at $48 and the long-stay tests; RV sites are the bulk of the resort (15 cabins). Google 4.5/61, RV Life unrated. Lakefront kept on the shoreline row. Note cleaned.
flags: PRICE GATE pass: 'Other Sites $48.00' nightly (a 23-ft motorhome fits; the $26 rate is for tents). Lakefront $55 is above $50, but the cheapest RV site is under it. Air conditioning or electric heaters add '$5.00 extra per day' when used.

LONG-STAY tests pass: (1) $48; (2) nightly rates posted with phone '1-800-777-7231' / 218-757-3144, no application or lease; (3) only '3 night minimum on Holiday weekends'; (4) seasonal count not stated ('Seasonal Sites: Rates based on availibility'), so pass; (5) not a home community. No operator wording discourages nightly guests. Leaf-off imagery shows about two dozen trailers left on sites, so a share is seasonal.
RESORT-CABIN rule pass: 15 weekly cabins (Saturday-to-Saturday) against ~80 campsites sold by the night; RV sites are not an afterthought.
GOOGLE 4.5 from 61 reviews; RV Life 'Pine Acres Resort Campground' unrated (0 ratings), 80 sites, $ tier.
